copy_rule: Every file from the new source-research directory is retained byte-identically here; this provenance sidecar is additional. No earlier finding or original PDF was overwritten.
source_preservation: Fresh acquisition originals and redundant publication originals remain separately named in the verified Intel store. Public source and image paths use Git LFS pointers to hash-verified payloads.
authority: Public research only; not a litigation record, native model experiment, accepted historical causal result or attribution of conduct.
identity: Commit and push through the existing AveLyra gitave helper after account and public destination verification
discrepancy_status: All measured differences retained; no preferred version or causal explanation selected
